question: Which body part do we tap on the floor when we dance to a beat? 👞
explanation: Great job! We tap our feet on the floor to follow the rhythm and dance! 🦶

question: What do we do with our hands to make a loud, happy beat? 👏
explanation: Awesome! We clap our hands together to make a fun rhythm! 👏
hint: You do this to show you liked a show.

question: How can we show a happy feeling while dancing? 😊
explanation: Super! A big smile shows everyone that we are feeling happy and joyful! 😁
hint: This shows your teeth in a nice way.

question: If we want to dance like a beautiful bird, what do we move? 🦅
explanation: Great job! We flap our arms up and down just like a flying bird! 🕊️

question: When the music is very fast, how do we usually dance? 🏃
explanation: Awesome! We move our bodies fast to match the quick music! 🐇
hint: Think of how a cheetah runs.

question: How can we show a sad feeling in our dance? 😢
explanation: Super! Looking down and moving slowly helps show a sad feeling. 😔
hint: Your face looks like a frown.

question: What do we do to dance gracefully like a tall tree in the wind? 🌳
explanation: Great job! Swaying our arms gently looks just like tree branches in the wind! 🌿
hint: Move gently from side to side.

question: If we spin around in a circle, what is it called? 🌀
explanation: Awesome! Spinning around gracefully is called twirling! 🩰
hint: It starts with the letter T.

question: What do we listen to so we know how to move? 🎵
explanation: Super! We listen to the music and its beat to know how to dance! 🎶

question: Which animal do we copy when we jump up high in a dance? 🦘
explanation: Great job! Kangaroos jump very high, and we can jump like them too! 🦘
hint: It has a pouch for its baby.

question: How can we make a soft sound with our feet while dancing? 🤫
explanation: Awesome! Tiptoeing makes a very soft and quiet sound! 🩰

question: What can we wiggle to dance like falling rain? 🌧️
explanation: Super! Wiggling our fingers pointing down looks just like raindrops falling! 🖐️
hint: You have ten of these on your hands.

question: How do we make our body look very small in a dance? 🐁
explanation: Great job! Bending our knees and crouching makes us look tiny! ⬇️

question: What part of our face shows we are surprised? 😲
explanation: Awesome! Opening our eyes very wide shows that we are surprised! 👁️

question: What is it called when we move our head up and down to the music? 🎧
explanation: Super! Moving your head up and down to the beat is called nodding! 😌

question: How can we dance like a beautiful butterfly? 🦋
explanation: Great job! Butterflies move very gently, so we float gracefully! 🌸

question: If we want to show anger in a dance, what can we do? 😠
explanation: Awesome! Stomping our feet strongly can show that we feel angry! 🦶
hint: Make a loud thump on the floor.

question: What do we do to stretch our body as high as possible? 🦒
explanation: Super! Reaching our arms way up makes us as tall as a giraffe! ☁️

question: What instrument makes a loud BOOM sound for us to step to? 🥁
explanation: Great job! The drum gives us a strong, loud beat to follow! 🥁

question: When we dance with our friends, what shape do we often make together? ⭕
explanation: Awesome! Holding hands in a big circle is a fun way to dance together! ⭕
hint: It is round like a wheel.

question: What do we do when the music suddenly stops? 🛑
explanation: Super! It is super fun to freeze like a statue when the music stops! 🥶

question: How do we dance if the music is very slow and quiet? 🐢
explanation: Great job! We match the music by moving our bodies very slowly! 🐌

question: What is it called when we move our hips side to side? 💃
explanation: Awesome! Moving our hips gently from side to side is called swaying. 〰️

question: What should we do to prepare our bodies before we dance? 🧘
explanation: Super! We stretch and warm up so our bodies are ready to move safely! 🤸

question: Which animal moves slowly on the ground, twisting its body? 🐍
explanation: Great job! A snake slithers and twists slowly on the ground. 🐍

question: How do we show we are holding something very heavy in a dance? 🏋️
explanation: Awesome! We pretend to use a lot of strength to show the object is heavy! 🧗
hint: Act like it is hard to lift.

question: What do we do to make a snappy sound with our hands? 🫰
explanation: Super! Snapping our fingers makes a sharp, cool sound for the beat! 🫰

question: What do we do at the very end of our dance to say thank you? 🙇
explanation: Great job! We take a graceful bow to thank everyone for watching us! 🙇

question: Which body part do we use to blink along with the music? 👁️
explanation: Awesome! We can open and close our eyes to match the fun beat! 👁️

question: What is it called when we walk proudly with stiff legs like a soldier? 🪖
explanation: Super! Marching is walking to a strong beat, just like soldiers do! 💂

question: How can we dance like a cute, hopping bunny? 🐰
explanation: Great job! We put our hands like paws and hop on both feet like a bunny! 🐾

question: What helps us to dance together at the exact same time? ⏱️
explanation: Awesome! Following the rhythm helps everyone dance together perfectly! 🥁
hint: It is the beat of the music.

question: What kind of face do we make to show we are scared in a dance? 😨
explanation: Super! Opening our mouth and eyes wide shows we are acting scared! 😱
hint: Like you just saw a ghost.

question: What part of our body connects our head to our shoulders? 🦒
explanation: Great job! We use our neck to turn our head side to side in a dance! 🦒
hint: A giraffe has a very long one.

question: How do we dance if we want to pretend to be a robot? 🤖
explanation: Awesome! Robots are made of metal, so we move very stiffly! 🤖

question: What is it called when we bend our body forward towards our toes? 🦶
explanation: Super! Bending forward makes our body flexible and is a great dance move! 🤸

question: Which of these animals waddles side to side when it walks? 🐧
explanation: Great job! Penguins waddle side to side, and we can dance like that too! 🐧
hint: It is a bird that lives in the ice.

question: What can we wear on our ankles to make a jingling sound while dancing? 🔔
explanation: Awesome! Bells (or ghungroos) make a lovely sound when we move our feet! 🎐

question: If you hold hands with a friend and spin, what are you doing? 🤝
explanation: Super! Dancing with a friend makes it a fun partner dance! 👯

question: How do we act in a dance if we pretend to be a floppy ragdoll? 🧶
explanation: Great job! Ragdolls have no bones, so we move our arms loosely! 〰️

question: What do we do with our shoulders to say 'I don't know' in a dance? 🤷
explanation: Awesome! Shrugging our shoulders is a fun way to express a feeling! 🤷

question: When we want to show love in a dance, what shape can we make with our hands? ❤️
explanation: Super! Making a heart with our hands shows lots of love and joy! 🫶
hint: It is red and beats in your chest.

question: What is the very first step to learn a new dance? 👣
explanation: Great job! We must watch our teacher and listen to the music first! 👀

question: How can we make a wavy movement with our arms? 🌊
explanation: Awesome! Moving arms up and down gently looks just like ocean waves! 〰️
hint: Move them like the sea water.

question: What do we do to practice balancing on one foot? 🦩
explanation: Super! Balancing on one leg makes our dance strong and steady, like a flamingo! 🦵
hint: Lift the other foot in the air.

question: What do we use to express feelings in a dance without talking? 🤫
explanation: Great job! We use our face, hands, and body to tell a beautiful story! 🧍

question: Which of these is a great way to cool down after a long dance? 🌬️
explanation: Awesome! Taking slow, deep breaths helps our heart and body relax. 🧘

question: What do we call the colorful clothes we wear for a special dance? 👗
explanation: Super! Costumes make our dance look bright, beautiful, and special! 👘

question: How should we feel when we are dancing to our favorite song? 🎉
explanation: Great job! Dancing is a wonderful way to have fun and feel happy! 🥳

question: What makes a dancer get better and better every day? ✨
explanation: Awesome! Practicing every day helps us become amazing dancers! 💪
